specs-o.esr_esl_dc_bias_source-s: Würth Elektronik LTspice model library LTSpice_WCAP-ATG8 (rev22a, 2022-06-01).zip (we-online.com WCAP-ATG8 product page), subckt 860010473007_100uF: Rser 0.488708 ohm, Lser 4.372 nH, C 100 µF, Rpar 1 Mohm -> esr_mohm = Rser (model is frequency-independent, so also the ESR at SRF), esl_ph = Lser, srf_mhz = 1/(2 pi sqrt(Lser C)). Model values, not a measured curve; temperature not stated. DC bias not applicable (electrolytic). Würth catalog row: ripple 209 mA, DF 14 %, leakage 25 µA, 2000 h. Read 2026-10-21

component-o.description-s: 100 µF ±20% 25 V aluminum electrolytic capacitor, WCAP-ATG8 (general purpose, 85 °C 2000 h), radial can 6.3 x 11 mm, 2.5 mm lead pitch, ammopack

non-technical-o.cost-source-s: DigiKey API v4 StandardPricing, USD, 2026-10-21: per quantity the lowest unit price among DigiKey's own non-Digi-Reel packagings whose first break is at or below that quantity (732-8630-1-ND Cut Tape (CT), 732-8630-3-ND Tape & Box (TB))
